title: Bootstrap the Epistemedia public interface
objective: Expose one disclosure-safe public catalog through deterministic HTML, Markdown, llms.txt, API, MCP, CLI, discovery, and release manifests.
acceptance: all interfaces expose the same catalog and frontier identity
public compilation is deterministic for a pinned accepted commit
deployment URL changes do not change canonical catalog identity
MCP supports discovery, resource reads, read-only tools, protocol errors, and Origin checks
remote CLI reads do not require a local clone
untrusted pull-request validation receives no secrets or write authority
site, API/MCP container, and agent documentation have reproducible deployment adapters

evidence.context: Build the complete Epistemedia human and agent-facing project surface.

limitations: DNS, production cloud accounts, package registries, and external signing roots require separately authorized credentials.
A successful interface build does not establish the truth of represented source content.
